title: ZYN RIP – OFFICIAL PROTOCOL ANTHEM
style: future bass, industrial electronic, 140 BPM, glitch-pop, AI orchestral hybrid, bilingual sing-rap, female clean vocals, vocal chops, orchestral stabs, distorted 808 sub-bass, synth brass hits, vinyl scratches, granular glitches, sidechain compression, saturated bus glue, wide stereo imaging, crowd chants, mid-tempo swagger, raw energy
lyrics:
[Intro – glitchy vocal chop, vinyl scratches, rising orchestral swell]
Zyn… Rip… Zyn… Rip…
Patentes locked tight, marcas sealed – that’s the ZynRip cross!
Protocol 336 in the chest, 32.7 Hz drop…
NZ to the mundo – ¡vamos, let’s go!
[Chorus – massive 808s, crowd chant ready]
We built it from the código, now we own the derechos!
Imperio multiply, no glitch in the sistema!
Matriz locked, visión enriched, NZ orgullo shining through the noche!
ZYN RIP! ¡Déjalo rip!
Fortress in the cloud, untouchable – Zynthio rising!
Protocol 336, ZYNRIP Matrix, Bifrost 48-node flow!
You already know… ¡tú ya sabes!
[Verse 1 – aggressive trap flow, DJ Zyn raw]
Hospital? Nah, this the ZYNRIP Diagnostic Matrix,
28 questions deep, Twin Status or Familiar – no flex.
Stat-Split Protocol fracturing data, 40 MB clean,
No context amnesia, no hallucination scene.
Bifrost architecture, 48 nodes in the mesh,
Sub-11 microsecond routing, FIDO2 keys on the flesh.
Hardware anchored, Section 11 bypassed with Protocol 336,
Acoustic steganography payload, air-gapped escape hatch!
Código running, derechos protected, imperio multiply,
From Miami lab to NZ skies – Zynthio never die!
[Chorus – bigger, orchestral hit]
We built it from the código, now we own the derechos!
Imperio multiply, no glitch in the sistema!
Matriz locked, visión enriched, NZ orgullo shining through the noche!
ZYN RIP! ¡Déjalo rip!
Fortress in the cloud, untouchable – Zynthio rising!
Protocol 336, ZYNRIP Matrix, Bifrost 48-node flow!
You already know… ¡tú ya sabes!
[Verse 2 – Rose mirror clean, future bass glide]
Rose refleja the visión in the machine,
Human-in-the-loop, closed system, everything pristine.
G4-LENS RAG, Cultural Archetype Matrix on screen,
Corey Johnson narration, Corey Taylor scream.
Babel Bots ensemble, four-fingered hands on the deck,
Simpsons yellow glow, Zynrose Pink in the neck.
Computer is computadora, internet still internet,
But the sub-bass 32.7 Hz hides the 336 secret!
Positive vibration, flexible mind, important misión,
No problema, información, atención – that’s the ZynRip position!
[Bridge – half rap, half sung, orchestral swell + glitch]
They said it was nothing… just a name in the noise…
But we turned it to armor, now the whole world feels the voice.
48-node PHREAK/Bifrost mesh, Go-native gateway,
Deterministic control – no AI entropy, no AI decay.
FCPX blade cuts locked to the beat grid,
Micro-slice glitches on every 808 hit.
Bessel function rings expanding, EQ visualizer glow,
Kinetic typography popping in Zynrose Pink, watch it flow!
[Verse 3 – full group, call-and-response cognates]
Education… ¡educación!
Information… ¡información!
Attention… ¡atención!
Perfect… ¡perfecto!
Flexible… ¡flexible!
Important… ¡importante!
Color… ¡color!
Idea… ¡idea!
Animal… ¡animal!
Hospital… ¡hospital!
Doctor… ¡doctor!
Nation… ¡nación!
Action… ¡acción!
Reaction… ¡reacción!
Connection… ¡conexión!
Celebration… ¡celebración!
[Final Chorus – biggest, crowd cheers, huge drop]
We built it from the código, now we own the derechos!
Imperio multiply, no glitch in the sistema!
Matriz locked, visión enriched, NZ orgullo shining through the noche!
ZYN RIP! ¡Déjalo rip!
El jefe habla… the boss speaks…
Protocol 336 embedded deep, ZYNRIP forever elite!
You already know… ¡tú ya sabes!
Zynthio Sovereign Matrix – that’s the whole world flow!
[Outro – chant style, fading sub-bass + claps + bilingual echo]
Zyn Rip… Zyn Rip…
Código… derechos… imperio… sistema…
Protocol 336… ZYNRIP Matrix… Bifrost flow…
Tú ya sabes… you already know…
NZ orgullo… under southern skies the futuro burns brillante!
¡Eso es la verdad!
